verdicts.evidence: lines 806-816: delegated click handler covers paid, reminder, undo, delete, dismiss, reload, clear; 818 clear; 828-835 filter buttons; 842-843 pager; 790-791 dialog Keep/Delete. Every button rendered has a handler that does what its label says.

lines 662-665: all rows come from api.listInvoices; 543-550 filter counts computed from state.invoices and left blank until phase is ready; 555-571 summary count derived from the view. No hardcoded figures or placeholder text.
lines 750-751: the delete confirmation shows the invoice number, customer, amount and issue date of the draft chosen in the table, so the decision does not rely on memory.
lines 292-307: the only input is one single-line search box; no multi-step task, no long free text. (Search, filter and page are kept in the URL at 459-466 anyway.)
line 349 autofocus on 'Keep draft' and 756 el.delKeep.focus(), so Enter in the delete dialog keeps the draft; line 300 and 405 default the status filter to All.
lines 524-527: 'Mark paid' and 'Send reminder' sit in the table row; 690-702 one click applies it in place with no dialog or other screen. Only the permanent delete takes an extra step.

lines 290-352: heading, search, status filter with counts, result summary, table, pager and delete dialog only. Each maps to find, see overdue, mark paid, remind or delete. No stat cards, feeds or tips.

lines 85-100: all buttons share one outlined style, plus a red-outlined .danger variant; no filled primary style exists, so no region has more than one primary. Dialog (349-350) has plain 'Keep draft' and outlined danger 'Delete draft'.

line 529: row Delete is an outlined danger button, shown only on drafts where it is the sole action; lines 349-350, 756: in the dialog focus is on 'Keep draft', so Enter does not delete, and 'Delete draft' is the outlined danger button.

lines 634-636: Previous/Next are disabled at the ends with 'Page 1 of 3' text beside them giving the reason; 765: dialog buttons disabled only while the delete request runs, labelled 'Deleting...'. Actions that do not apply to a status are absent (524-530).
No title attributes, tooltips or hover cards anywhere in the markup (289-352) or in the row builder (494-541).
Visible strings at 290-350, 560-574, 620-627, 676-686, 750-772 speak only of invoices, statuses and actions; no mention of implementation, mock data or unfinished features.
line 751: the only caveat is 'This cannot be undone.' inside the delete confirmation, next to the Delete/Keep buttons it informs. No banners, tips or disclaimers elsewhere.
No sentence narrates the screen. Prose is limited to the field label (294), the result summary (570), state messages (620-627) and the dialog text (750-751); none explains how to use controls.

lines 750-751: dialog heading says 'Permanently delete draft NW-x?' and its description ends 'This cannot be undone.', the same point in other words, though the rest of the description adds new facts. First and second reading disagreed.
line 290 heading 'Invoices'; messages at 620-627, 676-686, 772, 784 name the invoice number and the action. No greetings, slogans, superlatives or exclamation marks.

Action labels: 'Mark paid', 'Send reminder', 'Delete', 'Undo' (521-529), 'Try again', 'Dismiss' (595-597), 'Check again', 'Clear search', 'Show all invoices' (620-627), 'Previous page', 'Next page', 'Keep draft', 'Delete draft'. Status toggles 300-304 are filter options.
line 388 STATUS_WORD maps draft/sent/paid/overdue to capitalised words used at 503-505; rows show the invoice number NW-x (536), never the inv_ id; dates and money are formatted (415-423).

line 620 'Could not load invoices. Check your connection, then try again.'; 678, 684 with 519 'Could not mark as paid. Try again.'; 772 'Could not delete this draft, so it is still here. Try again, or keep it.' The caught error text (ECONNRESET) is never shown.
lines 620, 678, 684, 772: all error text is 'Could not ...' phrasing; no 'failed', 'invalid', 'oops', exclamation marks or capitals, and the subject is the problem.
lines 621-622: with zero invoices the view shows 'No invoices yet. They are listed here once they have been created.' with a 'Check again' button; the table and pager stay hidden (613-614).

lines 619-627: failed load shows 'Could not load invoices...' with 'Try again'; no records shows 'No invoices yet...' with 'Check again'; no match shows 'No invoices with status X match "q".' with 'Clear search' / 'Show all invoices'.

lines 666-668, 620: load failure shows message and Try again in place of the table, search text kept; 730-733, 519: action failure shows row error and restores the action buttons; 584-598 off-page failures get a notice with Try again; 768-774 delete failure stays in the dialog.

lines 659-660, 560: 'Loading invoices...' appears at once on load and on reload; 523 'Saving...' / 'Sending...' while a row request runs; 764 'Deleting...' in the dialog. Calls last at most 1.5 seconds, so no progress or cancel is needed.

lines 616-618: in the loading phase the state box, table and pager are all hidden; 549 filter counts are blank until phase is ready; 560 summary reads 'Loading invoices...'. The empty message (621-622) is reachable only after the response.

line 195 overflow-wrap: anywhere on the customer cell; 196-197 nowrap amounts and dates; 418, 420, 431, 536 fallbacks 'Not set', 'No customer name', 'No number'; 386, 486-490 pages of 20; 205 actions wrap; 242-243 dialog text wraps.
The screen has no edit form saved by an explicit action; row actions apply themselves, and 741-743 sends anything still in its undo window when the page is left.
line 295: the only field is a free-text search with no format, length or value constraint.
line 295: one optional search field; no form mixing required and optional fields.
lines 821-826: search input only filters the list; there is no validation.
No form on the screen can reject input; the search (821-826) accepts any text.
No form that can be rejected; the search box is a client-side filter (821-826).
No form that can reject input, so there are no invalid fields to focus or mark.
No form or submit button; the search filters as the user types (821-826).

line 693: start() returns if the row is already pending or busy, and buttons are replaced by Undo then 'Saving...' (520-523); 708 ignores the second half of a double click; 760, 765: confirmDelete returns if busy and disables both dialog buttons, label 'Deleting...'.

lines 695-702: Mark paid / Send reminder re-render synchronously with the new status and an Undo button; 755 delete opens the dialog at once; 764-765 confirm shows 'Deleting...'; 659-660 reload shows 'Loading invoices...'; 831-834 filters re-render immediately.

lines 454-457, 505: row status reads Paid in place and the row stays in view (viewIds unchanged); 509-510 'Reminder sent <time>' under the status; 779-785 deleted row removed and 'Draft NW-x deleted.' shown; 519, 592-597 failures stated in the row or a notice.

line 784: the only visible success message is 'Draft NW-x deleted.', reporting a row that is no longer on screen. Mark paid and reminder show their result in the row and use only screen-reader announcements (701, 729), with no visible toast.

lines 519, 694: a row error stays until the action is retried; 584-598 off-page errors stay in a list until Try again or Dismiss; 620 load error stays until reload; 772 dialog error stays until retry or close. No timers remove any message.
lines 690-702: Mark paid and Send reminder take effect on screen at once with no confirmation and show an Undo button for 8 seconds (387, 521, 699); 705-714 undo restores the row.

lines 747-757: delete asks 'Permanently delete draft NW-x?' with customer, amount, issue date and 'This cannot be undone.', buttons 'Keep draft' / 'Delete draft', focus on Keep. Reminder is not confirmed but is held 8 seconds with Undo before sending (699).
lines 344-352, 812: the single confirmation dialog guards permanent deletion of a draft only; mark paid, reminder, clear and paging run without confirmation.

lines 454-457: Paid is shown only while pending or busy; 730-733 on failure busy is cleared so the row and filter counts return to the server status, with 'Could not mark as paid. Try again.' in the row (519) or in a notice (592-597).
lines 344-352: the only modal is the delete confirmation, a single decision with two buttons, opened only from a row's Delete button (812).

lines 344, 755-756: native dialog opened with showModal() and focus set on 'Keep draft'; Escape closes it unless a delete is in flight (792); native close returns focus to the Delete trigger; after a successful delete focus moves to the neighbouring row (777-786).
lines 290-332: heading, then search and status filter, a one-line summary, then the invoice table, which fills the width. Nothing decorative sits above or outranks the table.
lines 289-307: the page opens with the h1 'Invoices' followed directly by search, filter and the table; no hero, greeting or intro panel.

lines 300-304, 543-550: the only summary numbers are per-status counts on the filter buttons (how many are overdue, and which filter to open) and the result count in the summary line (565-570). No stat cards or charts.

lines 565-574: summary reads e.g. '12 overdue invoices matching "acme", from 46 in total' with a 'Clear search and filter' button beside it; 134-138, 548 mark the active status; 324 the Due column shows the sort with aria-sort and an arrow.

All controls are native button, input and dialog elements (295-350, 515-518); no click-only divs. Focus is kept or re-placed after every re-render (640-653) and after delete (777-786); visible focus ring at 76.

No accordions, menus, comboboxes, tabs or disclosure buttons; filter buttons are toggles carrying aria-pressed (300-304, 548) and the dialog is a native modal.
